narrative: The letter, open. A short letter, the canvas of silver beside it, not yet tied. The letter, open. The same sheet, three names, and a commendation. Nothing about the price of butter. Nothing about a prison. The letter, open. The foot of the sheet. The date. No second paragraph.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the short letter and dated it the twenty-sixth.

entities.name: letter
entities.context: Shown on letter in The line, and the canvas
